# Omapresent 0.1.0

Omapresent is a Markdown-only presentation app for Omarchy.

- Edit Markdown and preview the current slide live.
- Present on one or two displays with fragments, notes, recall slides, and
  mirrored scrolling.
- Export the shared renderer to PDF or an offline-capable web bundle.
- Use local media, explicit remote media loading, math, QR codes, and Bento
  image layouts without runtime renderer dependencies.
- Install the bundled Omapresent agent skill with the package.

This release is prepared for the Omarchy package repository. Package
availability remains pending repository review and publication.
